descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-08 step 1, ER 1, ER 5; TFA-92586 AC 2, AC 3, AC 5 · “Confirm it generates summaries across multiple patients in one action, not one patient at a time.”.

Approach · TC-08 Handoff Summary · S01 Hospital: one tap on Handoff generates every patient's summary, each card with all four sections and only its own facts

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 From the home screen, one tap on 'Handoff' generates summaries for the physician's patients in one action, not one patient at a time. (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U2 Each patient's handoff has four sections: active issues, discharge barriers, pending results, to-do/if-then. (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U7 Sections populate only from stored data: an empty section stays empty (no discharge barrier invented when no discharge task exists, no invented pending result), and nothing in the handoff is invented … (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 5; UAT 3.4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh physician with three Hospital patients seeded as charts, each with one important point and four open tasks: a discharge barrier, an awaited result, an if-then line, and a pharmacy call carrying that patient's unique token

When From the Hospital list tap Handoff once, wait until no 'Generating' message is showing and Send is enabled, save the sheet, then tap Copy Text (the runner reads the clipboard)

Then One sheet lists all three patients; every card has all four sections (active issues, discharge barriers, pending results, to-do/if-then) with its own important point under Active Issues; no card carries another patient's facts or token; no patient had to be opened or generated one at a time

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs. s01-hosp-sheet: the three names, '3 patients', an enabled Send, each of the four headings at least 3 times (minCount), no 'Generating', no Nursing Home resident. s01-hosp-copytext: the runner's clipboard text split into one block per numbered patient header ('1. NAME | Room …'); …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S01 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-08.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
